SELECT c.CONCERT_ID -- 공연아이디 , c.TITLE -- 공연명 , c.POSTER_FILE_ID -- 포스터파일ID , v.VENUE_NM -- 공연장명 , s.START_DT -- 공연일시(1회차) , s.END_DT -- 공연일시(N회차) , s.SALE_STATUS -- 회차상태(예매 중, 마감) , (CASE WHEN s.SALE_STATUS = 'READY' THEN s.DAYS_LEFT END) AS DAYS_UNTIL_OPEN -- 예매 오픈까지 남은 일수(READY일 때만) FROM CONCERT c JOIN VENUE v ON c.VENUE_ID = v.VENUE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT
cs.CONCERT_ID , MIN(cs.SHOW_DT) AS START_DT , MAX(cs.SHOW_DT) AS END_DT , MIN(CASE WHEN SYSDATE < cs.SALE_OPEN_DT THEN TRUNC(cs.SALE_OPEN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) END) AS DAYS_LEFT , CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN cs.SALE_OPEN_DT AND cs.SALE_CLOSE_DT THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 'ON_SALE' WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN SYSDATE < cs.SALE_OPEN_DT THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 'READY' ELSE 'CLOSED' END AS SALE_STATUS
FROM CONCERT_SCHEDULE cs GROUP BY cs.CONCERT_ID ) s ON c.CONCERT_ID = s.CONCERT_ID WHERE c.STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND (s.END_DT IS NULL OR s.END_DT >= SYSDATE) ORDER BY s.START_DT
